description: This file defines storage interfaces, types, and functions for Kubernetes API server storage layer, including versioning, object metadata, watch options, and key validation.

methods.name: UpdateObject
methods.description: Sets storage metadata into an API object; may return an error if update fails.

methods.name: UpdateList
methods.description: Sets the resource version into an API list object; may return an error if update fails.

methods.name: PrepareObjectForStorage
methods.description: Sets SelfLink and ResourceVersion to empty values; may return an error.

methods.name: ObjectResourceVersion
methods.description: Returns the resource version of the object for persistence; may return an error.

methods.name: ParseResourceVersion
methods.description: Converts a resource version string to a uint64 for storage backend.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Enforces preconditions (UID and ResourceVersion) on a runtime object.

methods.name: ValidateAllObjectFunc
methods.description: A ValidateObjectFunc that admits all objects (no validation).
